text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the color of my tips is...? Fufu, 
looks like it's changing again.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
There are plenty of famous Umamusume who 
seized glory while changing their forms 
like this, after all...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: In that case, just like them... I too—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu, just kidding. I suppose I'm 
jumping to conclusions."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Still, this must surely be a positive 
change... I know, perhaps I should try out 
a new ear accessory.
